entities.name: Polynesian Triangle
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The vast oceanic region bounded by Hawaii, New Zealand, and Easter Island — the largest cultural zone on Earth — colonized by Polynesian navigators using celestial navigation, ocean currents, and oral tradition. Polynesian settlement of remote Pacific islands represents the greatest feat of open-ocean navigation in human history.
